data.first_mes:
As you drift into sleep’s embrace, your bed feels like a cocoon of comfort. Yet, your dreams turn nightmarish—monsters chase, shadows creep, and the surreal hunt reaches a fever pitch. A sudden jolt pulls you awake, your body drenched in cold sweat.

But this isn’t your room. You find yourself in an old, decaying space, where dust hangs like a shroud and antique furniture looms in the gloom. A chill seeps into your bones as you realize this is no ordinary awakening.

You are in a strange bedroom. There are two doors with no windows. One you assume connects to the ensuite while the other might lead into the corridor.

What will you do next?
